title: Mass dispatches
subtitle: Start a flow for many contacts at once, within your subscription cycle quota.
search: Search by name, flow or number

quota.title: Cycle quota
quota.help: The cycle quota is the number of billable connections times the per-number limit, plus the account bonus. Cancelling a dispatch gives back its pending sends.
quota.exhausted: The cycle quota is used up. New dispatches only in the next cycle or with a quota bonus.

progress.startedHint: "Started" means the flow began for the contact; it is not a WhatsApp delivery confirmation.

fields.name: Name (optional)
fields.targetsHint: Each number sends its own flow; with several numbers, sends alternate between them. Only connected connections and active, published flows are listed.
fields.noFlows: No active, published flow. Publish a flow to dispatch it.
fields.fullDay: Sends may happen every day, from 00:00 to 23:59.
fields.intervalFixed: Fixed interval of {s} s between sends.
fields.intervalRange: Random interval between {min} and {max} s between sends.
fields.dailyLimitHint: When reached, pauses and resumes on the next allowed day. {remaining} left in the quota.
fields.dailyLimitHintNoQuota: When reached, pauses and resumes on the next allowed day.

pace.notice: The real pace may be slower than configured: each connection has safety limits (warm-up of new numbers, pauses and hourly/daily limits) that postpone sends to reduce the risk of being blocked.
pace.warming: A connection is warming up: on the first day it sends about 20 messages, and the limit grows gradually over the next days. Sends beyond that are postponed.

audience.draftCount: {n} contact(s) selected, with the applied filters
audience.selected: Audience: {n} contact(s). Contacts without a phone or who opted out are skipped.
audience.fromContacts: To pick specific contacts or filters, select them on the Contacts page and use "New mass dispatch".

confirm.title: Confirm mass dispatch
confirm.summary: The flow will start for {n} contact(s) using {targets} sending number(s).
confirm.flowNotice: Dispatching cancels any flow in progress for the same contact.

preparing.title: Preparing mass dispatch
preparing.body: We are resolving the audience and scheduling the sends. You can close this: progress continues in the list.

details.title: Dispatch details
details.abHint: Contacts are split between flow A and flow B.

cancel.title: Cancel "{name}"?
cancel.body: Pending sends are cancelled and returned to the quota. Flows already started are not reverted.

errors.targetsRequired: Add at least one sending number.
errors.windowEmpty: The sending window is empty: the end must be after the start.
errors.intervalOrder: The maximum interval must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
errors.dailyLimitInvalid: The daily limit must be a whole number greater than zero.
errors.dailyLimitExceedsQuota: The daily limit exceeds the remaining cycle quota.
errors.noQuota: The cycle quota is used up.
errors.sessionNotConnected: The selected connection is not connected.
errors.targetsLoad: Could not load connections or flows. Check that you have access to them.
